rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for adding a contrasting point or saying “nevertheless.”

example.english: Nevertheless, we still have to go even though it is raining.
example.jyutping: bat1 gwo3 lok6 jyu5 dou1 jiu3 ziu3 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for the more conversational “but” or “yet” meaning when linking two contrasting clauses.

example.english: I am really tired today, but nevertheless I still have to finish the report.
example.traditional: 但係我今日真係好攰，都要做埋份報告。
example.jyutping: daan6 hai6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gui6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 maai4 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this when explicitly referring back to the preceding situation and meaning “even so” or “despite that.”

example.english: Nevertheless, you still should not scold him.
example.traditional: 就算係咁，你都唔應該鬧佢。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 hai6 gam2 nei5 dou1 m4 jing1 goi1 naau6 keoi5
